en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Nuh ibn Shu’ayb from certain persons of our people from Musa ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Hassan who has said the following: “I have heard my shaykh’s saying, ‘
The milk of camels is a cure for all kinds of illness and defects, and for one’s stomach trouble it is their urine.’”
